signals.note: Small systematic review links preserved endogenous secretion (measure type unspecified) to successful prandial insulin withdrawal on GLP-1 therapy; weak, not guideline-sourced.

new_candidates.title: Predictors of Successful Prandial Insulin Withdrawal Following the Initiation of GLP-1-Based Therapy in Adults With T2D: A Systematic Review
new_candidates.why: Possible use of an endogenous-secretion measure (type unspecified, possibly C-peptide) to guide insulin treatment simplification in T2D; abstract-level only, no guideline source.
